name: sheepfold
title: Stâna de pe deal (Cipru)
units: engine units (figure 4.2 tall), three.js Y-up, +Z towards the usual camera

gate.note: in front of the gate, facing it (to open it / reach over it)

gate-left.note: in front of the fold left of the gate, facing it

gate-right.note: in front of the fold right of the gate, facing it

fold-in.note: inside the fold, just behind the gate, facing the sheep

fold.note: the middle of the fold (sheep all round)

hut.note: in front of the house door, facing out

hut-door.note: standing in the doorway, facing out

hut-in.note: inside, just behind the closed door (start hidden here, show, open the door, walk out)

tree.note: under the olive tree (the owl above), facing the camera side

center.note: the middle of the meadow in front of the fold

path-left.note: on the path from the left, facing along it towards the gate

path-mid.note: on the path from the left, facing along it towards the gate

path-near.note: on the path from the left, facing along it towards the gate

path-hut.note: on the path between the gate and the house, facing the house

offstage-left.note: out of frame on the path, left (enter walking +X)

wide.note: the fold in the middle, the olive tree left, the house right, hills behind

gate.note: the gate and the sheep behind it

notes: The fold: an oval dry-stone wall 1.5 high round [0, -9.5] (half axes 7.5 × 5.5), its gate at the front (x = 0, z = -4, node door:gate, hinge on the left post; open = swings inwards). Sheep inside are set dressing (col:sheepN). The house: door node door:hut at x = 19, front wall z = -6.5 (hut-in = behind the closed door). Collision: col:foldN, col:gatepost*, col:sheepN, col:hut-*, col:olive*, col:cypressN, col:bushN, col:trough, col:beehives.
